description: This is a test class for the EmployeeMembershipService, located within the PIM Service plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations and searching employee membership data, utilizing mocks and fixtures.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipServiceTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the EmployeeMembershipService methods, including retrieval, saving, deleting, and searching employee memberships within the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeMembershipService, and populates test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an EmployeeMembership object by ID, verifying the subscription fee.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeMembership object and verifying that fields are correctly set after persistence.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple EmployeeMembership records and verifies the count of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests searching for EmployeeMembership entries based on filter parameters, verifying count and object type.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of EmployeeMembership records that match specific search criteria.
